capabilities: Generate text from prompts, the current line, or selected text
Generate images from prompts, the current line, or selected text
Transcribe the last audio file above the current line
Generate text in context of Bing search results or an embedded PDF attachment
Create custom prompt commands from the plugin settings
extras: Custom prompt commands require reloading the plugin and restarting Obsidian to appear in the command palette. Installation from GitHub is described as a manual alternative.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to call AI models for generating text, images, or transcripts inside notes.

relations.evidence: AI Commander is a simple AI connector that helps you write notes with the power of OpenAI (ChatGPT) APIs
This allows the text model to work with Bing search engine. A Bing Web Search API key is required

summary: AI connector that generates text and images from prompts and audio transcripts via OpenAI, with Bing search results or embedded PDFs as context.
